sources: Hit structure: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0032_lizhiyan_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_* (game 1.6). Every damage unit is plain ATK × blackboard key (no atkCalculation), including the combo skill's 'seal' buffs, which take their keys from the combo skill by assignBlackboard: seal_total ← atk_scale_touch; seal2 / seal_listener / seal_bunshin_end_listener ← atk_scale_boom (as atk_scale_early_finish); seal_finisher_wisd ← atk_scale_laser1 ×4 then atk_scale_laser2. Their decorate mask 12288 is the combo skill's (combo_skill_abilityentity_end has the same). Mechanics and their evidence: docs/kit-batches/batch-1/chr_0032_lizhiyan.md (pass-2 and pass-3 plans).

Array Arcana is chosen by the passive buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_passive: Intellect ≥ Will → INT, else WILL, from operator level, talents, potentials, gear and weapon attributes only (talent 1 text). The kit writes INT as {attrAtLeast: [41, 42]} and WILL as its negation, so ties go to INT as in the game. activeConditions lizhiyan_wisd / lizhiyan_will are the same two (PotentialTalentEffectTable limits P1's and talent 1's effects by them).

Mode texts: CharGrowthTable skillGroupMap chr_0032_lizhiyan_ComboSkill pairs conditionId1 'lizhiyan_wisd' (INT) with conditionPostDesc1 and conditionId2 'lizhiyan_will' (WILL) with conditionPostDesc2; the battle skill and ultimate use the same order.

Combo skill: seal_total (frame 9) starts Imprisonment (buff_…_combo_skill_seal) and its Susceptibility (…_spell_vulnerable_pre, its child) at once: trigger imprison at cast + 11 (seal_total frame 2), detached (nothing cuts the combo before 16). The touch (frame 15) gives `usp` energy; in WILL it adds an Arts Infliction of the enemy's current element (seal_total switches on EntityBB_consumed_type, set natively: open list A6, in-game test 33). Natural end → explosion at +14 (abilityentity_end); in INT also the bunshin_end_listener (int_after_end), whose next battle-skill hit returns SP and explodes again (int_late_hit; lasers after it: test 34). INT early end (the battle skill hits an Imprisoned enemy: seal2 abilityEvent 101 → seal_listener 204 → seal_again): SP atb_return_wisd, explosion, Imprisonment and its Susceptibility end, the post-Imprisonment Susceptibility (rate_pre, ended by the final laser 58 frames later) and lasers at +43/46/49/52/58 (btl_upload_d9e59d0fb737 has them ~1.5 frames earlier). In WILL nothing ends Imprisonment early (seal2's 101 handler checks isWisd), so WILL has no post-Imprisonment Susceptibility and no seal_finisher (unreachable).

Ultimate: frame 47 creates the array (listener_owner, `duration` 20 s, energy blocked, ult slot → Gloompurge Arcana) and, in WILL, talent 1's Susceptibility, both before the hit's DamageAction (serverActionIndex 45 / 79 vs 82): hit buffs with beforeDamage, so INT Amp (array_start) and the equipment's category triggers act on the hit (btl_upload_dbaee23b801d's ultimate matches only with buff_wpn_funnel_0016_will_dmg on it). Cluster Strike (inaura abilityEvent 101): a Final Strike by the controlled operator (lasers at +15/19/23/27, 0.4 s debounce) or a Finisher (once per finisher, lasers at +12/16/20/24), each +50% max energy (usp_step, ignoreUspGainScalar) past the block; the second ends the array and starts Gloompurge Arcana (listener: energy cleared, then +100%, 10 s; its length and whether casting ult 2 ends it: test 32). The array ending with fewer than 2 strikes, and Gloompurge ending, clear energy (−999). buff_…_ultimate_skill_inaura_attack is referenced by nothing; a third strike (laser3) can't happen (the second ends the array entity).

Talent 1 (values from chr_0032_lizhiyan_talent1 by {talent: 0}): WILL Susceptibility min(Will × spell_vul_rate_per_will, spell_vul_rate) + spell_vul_rate_potential on Nature and Cryo for the talent's `duration` 10 s (the ultimates read it with GetTargetBuffBBAdvanced desiredKey duration; test 30 confirms), on both ultimates; INT Arts Amp enhance_rate while the array or Gloompurge Arcana lasts (listener_owner / listener children; test 7). Both exist only when their value is above 0 (CompareFloat before the CreateBuff): talent 1 level 1 has 0 for both, so the kit guards them with talent 1 level 2 or P5. Talent 2: statusTweaks on every Corrosion she applies (duration_add, max resistance reduction × (1 + corrupt_rate)). P5 (WILL only): casting ult 2 cuts the combo's cooldown by cd_minus of its full cooldown (SetSkillCdAtOnce isPercentage; the meaning is assumed: open list V7, test 36).

Finisher (power_attack, BreakingAttackCalculation, mask 132): six landings at 7, 10, 13, 32, 34, 36 of atk_scale × multiplier 0.1 (×5) and 0.5; no Stagger (its DamageActions have no poise unit; the 5/5/5/20/20/10 DefiniteValueCalculation literals are hitEnvData, damage to scenery). It has no ObtainCostAction: the file default `atb` 8 isn't read by any action, so `sp: 0` (open list D2, test 31); the enemy's finisher SP stays.

Not modelled: Imprisonment's slow-down of the enemy's clock (SealAction curve 0.3 → 0.2 → 1.0) and hit-stops (open list Ti1b; tests 18, 37); whether an application that forms a reaction opens the combo window (the kit counts it since 2026-10-22 (`reactions: true`, the owner's reading; abilityEvent 126 fires before the game resolves the infliction; in-game test 35 can still confirm)); the paramType 4 half of talent 1 level 2 (R11, undecoded); buff_common_<element>_triggered's ×1.42 (open list L2).

Verified against logs (Rhodagn / Lv90 challenge, game 1.6): btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (P4, WILL) all 13 Arcane hits ±1 (touch ×2 = atk_scale_touch, ultimate with its talent-1 Susceptibility, attack1 ×3, attack2 ×3, plunge, cryst bursts ×3); btl_upload_0eef2474a26f (P5, WILL) touch and battle skill (atk_scale_will, under Corrosion level 2 from its own Nature-onto-Cryo reaction); btl_upload_bdf223db8e49, btl_upload_dbaee23b801d and btl_upload_e82d45c46040 (fixtures/pending). btl_upload_d9e59d0fb737 (the only INT battle, before 555me's 1.6 table commit 371c743) has every hit after her ultimate ×1.7–2.2 the 1.6 model, all under the ultimate's forced Corrosion; inside it the INT hits are mutually consistent (lasers / atk_scale_laser1, final laser / atk_scale_laser2 and attack1 / atk_scale give the same ×1.9617; seal2 / atk_scale_boom equals battle skill / atk_scale_wisd).
The timeline takes skill timing (lock, windows, channels) from SkillData.

stacks.label: Cluster Strikes
stacks.note: buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_ultimate_skill_layer: strikes inside the current array; reset when an array starts and when Gloompurge Arcana ends.

statusTweaks.note: Talent 2 (abilityEvent 202 on a Corrosion-tagged buff she applies): duration + duration_add (only if above 0), max_def_decrease × (1 + corrupt_rate). Forced and reaction Corrosion alike.

buffs.label: Imprisonment
buffs.note: buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_combo_skill_seal from seal_total frame 9: INT duration_pre + duration (4.633 s), WILL duration_pre + duration_will (6.633 s). Its slow-down of the enemy's clock isn't modelled (open list Ti1b, test 37).

buffs.label: Tactical Doubles Susceptibility
buffs.note: …_spell_vulnerable_pre, asChildBuff of the seal: rate_pre (P1 +0.06 in WILL), plus in WILL min(spell_vul_per_will × Will, max_spell_vul_will).

buffs.label: Post-Imprisonment Susceptibility (INT)
buffs.note: …_combo_skill_spell_vulnerable from seal_again (INT early end only): rate_final = rate_pre in INT; its duration_vul has no blackboard, so the default 12 s, ended by seal_finisher_wisd's final laser 58 frames after the early end.

buffs.label: Imprisonment ended early
buffs.note: Keeps the natural-end explosion quiet when Imprisonment was ended by the INT battle skill (the game's timed markers).

buffs.label: After a natural INT end
buffs.note: buff_…_combo_skill_seal_bunshin_end_listener (99 s, INT only, abilityentity_end frame 10): the next battle-skill hit returns SP and explodes again.

buffs.label: Gloompurger Array
buffs.note: buff_…_ultimate_skill_listener_owner: RefrainObtainUsp with clearUspOnEnd, ChangeSkillAction to ult 2 (castable only after two Cluster Strikes here: ult 2's `available`).

buffs.label: Gloompurge Arcana
buffs.note: buff_…_ultimate_skill_listener: ChangeSkillAction 10 s (lifeTimeType 2; the buff's own default 30 s isn't assigned). Whether casting ult 2 ends it: test 32.

buffs.label: Talent 1 Arts Amp (INT)
buffs.note: Child of listener_owner and then of listener: lasts the array and Gloompurge Arcana (ended by array_end / gloompurge_end). Test 7.

buffs.label: Talent 1 Susceptibility (WILL)
buffs.note: Applied by both ultimates before their hit, WILL only, when talent 1's value is above 0. Test 30 (10 s, a confirmation).

triggers.note: INT: a Nature Infliction by anyone opens the window.
INT: two or more stacks of Heat, Electric or Cryo by anyone.
WILL: any Arts Infliction by anyone.
seal_total frame 2 (cast + 11): teammates' hits from then see the Susceptibility.
seal2 abilityEvent 101 → seal_listener 204 → combo_skill_abilityentity_seal_again → seal_finisher_wisd. Frames from the battle-skill hit.
combo_skill_abilityentity_end: explosion at its frame 14; under INT also the bunshin_end_listener (frame 10).
bunshin_end_listener's handler: SP, explosion (atk_scale_early_finish ← atk_scale_boom), then it finishes itself. Lasers after it are unknown (test 34).
A new array: strikes reset; INT Amp when talent 1's value is above 0.

inaura abilityEvent 101, Final Strike path: target_mark 0.1 s, then if the array is up and no 0.4 s marker: laser buff by layer, energy usp_step (max energy / 2), layer +1. The second strike switches to Gloompurge Arcana (listener).
inaura abilityEvent 101, Finisher path (mask 4, is_power_attacked: once per finisher, no 0.4 s marker). Test 31.
listener_owner ends with fewer than 2 strikes: energy −999.
listener ends: layer counter reset, energy −999.
ultimate_skill2 frame 0 (WILL: EntityBB_wisd_greater_will = 0; cd_minus is 0 below P5). Meaning of isPercentage: test 36.

hits.note: Three ChannelingActions at frame 10, one hit per target each (display_atk_scale = 3 × atk_scale). Verified on btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (3 hits of 537, basic Lv11 0.129).
Verified on btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (3 hits of 712, 0.147 at Lv11).
Two damage actions at each of frames 2, 5, 8, 11 (display_atk_scale 0.8 = 8 × 0.1).
Uses the basic attack level. Verified on btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (8037, 1.66 at Lv11).

Final Strike (decorate mask 2097152 + basic): triggers Cluster Strike inside the array when Arcane is controlled. SP atb only if controlled; Stagger `poise` (10) too (its DamageAction's poise unit, onlyEnableForMainChar).

skills.label: Finisher
skills.note: Finisher (skillSpecification 8): castable on a Staggered enemy; the enemy's finisher multiplier applies. Its landings trigger Cluster Strike once per finisher inside the array.

hits.note: BreakingAttackCalculation multiplier 0.1. No Stagger: no damage unit is a poise one (the 5 / 20 / 10 literals are hitEnvData, damage to scenery).
Multiplier 0.1, no Stagger (the two share one action, to verify).
Multiplier 0.5, no Stagger; GainBreakingAttackAtb here. sp 0: the skill's unread `atb` 8 isn't SP (open list D2, test 31).

skills.label: Battle skill
skills.note: Description: "Creates a Jadecrushing Grid that deals Nature DMG and applies Nature Infliction to enemies within the area of effect." The skill spawns normal_skill_abilityrange2 at frame 0; its single hit lands at the entity's frame 20, after its Nature infliction in the same frame (so a Corrosion it causes already applies: btl_upload_0eef2474a26f). Mask 4352 = battle. The team's energy comes at 20 (buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp). Under INT, hitting an Imprisoned enemy ends the Imprisonment early (trigger int_early_end).

hits.label: Battle skill (Array Arcana: WILL)
hits.note: Verified on btl_upload_0eef2474a26f (18470, crit, under Corrosion level 2).

hits.label: Battle skill (Array Arcana: INT)
hits.note: conditionPostDesc1: "Array Arcana: INT: - Deals more DMG." Only in btl_upload_d9e59d0fb737 (under Corrosion, ×2.23 unexplained).

skills.label: Combo skill
skills.note: The cast creates buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_combo_skill_seal_total at frame 9: Imprisonment and its Susceptibility (trigger imprison), the Tactical Doubles hit at the buff's frame 6 (frame 15 of the skill). Explosions and lasers come from triggers (explosion, int_early_end, int_late_hit). Can't be cut before frame 16.

hits.label: Tactical Doubles hit
hits.note: One hit per target (four branches, one taken). Potential 1 multiplies atk_scale_touch by 1.3. Verified (0.8 × 1.3 = 1.04) on btl_upload_0eef2474a26f, btl_upload_e82d45c46040 ×2, btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 ×2. Energy: ObtainCostAction costValue usp (10) when the hit finds a target. WILL: another Arts Infliction of the enemy's current element (seal_total frame 6, before the damage; open list A6, test 33).

skills.label: Ultimate (Gloompurger Array)
skills.note: Energy: RefrainObtainUsp from the cast to frame 47 (energyBlockSeconds), then the array's block (gloompurger_array, blocksEnergy). Castable when neither the array nor Gloompurge Arcana is up. Doesn't take control (switchToCenterBeforeCast false). Can't be cut before 48.

hits.label: Array creation
hits.note: WILL (conditionPostDesc2): another Arts Infliction stack of the element the enemy has (Nature → Cryo → Electric → Heat), and talent 1's Susceptibility (logged 0.128 at Will 788 on btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8). INT (conditionPostDesc1): forced Corrosion (buff_common_natural_natural_corrupt_triggered, level `count` 1, duration2 15 s; talent 2 lengthens it). All before the DamageAction, with the array. Verified on btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8, btl_upload_e82d45c46040, btl_upload_dbaee23b801d.

skills.label: Ultimate sequence 2 (Gloompurge Arcana)
skills.note: Castable while Gloompurge Arcana lasts (after the second Cluster Strike), paid by its 100% energy grant. In INT, talent 1's Amp is already on (int_amp lasts Gloompurge Arcana). Can't be cut before 63.

hits.label: Gloompurge Arcana (WILL)
hits.note: Talent 1's WILL Susceptibility applies before this hit (frame 58). Not in any log yet.

hits.label: Gloompurge Arcana (INT)
hits.note: Potential 5 multiplies atk_scale by 1.3. Not in any log yet.
